population.snapshot: benchmarks/evaluation/real-project-v1/population.json, generated and committed after this protocol's merge and before any repository or declaration draw
population.eligibility: Public, non-fork, non-archived GitHub repositories returned by the recorded GitHub API snapshot; each must have a default-branch commit, an OSI-recognized license reported by GitHub, at least 100 stars at snapshot time, and the profile's root build marker (go.mod; pyproject.toml or setup.cfg; package.json plus tsconfig.json). The repository must contain at least 20 non-generated source files for its profile language after vendored, generated, dependency, and test-only paths are excluded.
population.exclusions: Forks, mirrors, archived repositories, repositories without the stated build marker or source-file count, repositories whose default-branch source archive exceeds 150 MiB, generated or vendored sources, tests, examples, benchmarks, lockfiles, declarations-only files, and declarations whose source-only review cannot establish an unambiguous location and at least one in-repository occurrence.

sampling.seedDerivation: For each language/candidate profile, rank every eligible repository by the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of `usagebench-real-project-v1\0` + the Git commit that introduced this protocol + `\0` + language + `\0` + candidate ID + `\0` + repository full name. Rank declaration candidates within each chosen pinned repository by the same digest with `declaration\0` and the portable source URI plus zero-based declaration range appended. Sort bytewise ascending; use source text and syntax only, never Bifrost or language-server outcomes.
sampling.replacementRule: Persist the complete ranked eligible population before drawing. If a chosen repository fails a stated eligibility check after its source archive is pinned, replace it with the next unselected repository in that profile's recorded rank order. If a declaration fails source-only authoring or independent review, replace it with the next recorded declaration candidate from the same pinned repository; if none remains, replace the repository using the same rank order. Record every exclusion and replacement in the selection manifest before any analyzer run.

claimScope: This frozen slice supports only descriptive, per-profile comparisons for the source-only sampled public repositories and the References and Definition operations recorded here. It does not estimate language-wide, ecosystem-wide, latency, memory, or cold-start performance.
